up: Retrieve the first 1000 IC50 activity rows with pChEMBL values for the human single-protein target CHEMBL2007625 (Isocitrate dehydrogenase [NADP] cytoplasmic). For each row, return the following columns: assay ChEMBL ID, target type, tax_id, canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, standard type, and pChEMBL value. Use only exact standard relation '=' rows with non-null pChEMBL values. Order the results by molecule ChEMBL ID and assay ChEMBL ID. The target is defined by its ChEMBL ID CHEMBL2007625, organism Homo sapiens, and target type SINGLE PROTEIN. The necessary joins are: activities to assays on assay_id, assays to target_dictionary on tid, activities to molecule_dictionary on molregno, and activities to compound_structures on molregno. Do not add any extra filters beyond what is specified.
sql: SELECT ass.chembl_id AS "assay ChEMBL ID", td.target_type AS "target type", td.tax_id AS "tax_id", cs.canonical_smiles AS "canonical SMILES", md.chembl_id AS "molecule ChEMBL ID", a.standard_type AS "standard type", a.pchembl_value AS "pChEMBL value" FROM activities a JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE a.standard_type = 'IC50' AND a.standard_relation = '=' AND a.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL AND td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL2007625' AND td.organism = 'Homo sapiens' AND td.target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN' ORDER BY md.chembl_id, ass.chembl_id LIMIT 1000;
